_meta.note: Boxes are CSS px relative to the layout root (main), or to the section for sectionBox. Text boxes are the tight bounds of the text itself (DOM Range), so they do not depend on which element holds the text.

texts.text: A pool party! Come for a swim, a light spread and cake. All the family welcome.
Sunday 1 November, from 2pm, come when you can
Your answer helps us plan. Come back here and update it if your plans change.
Add to calendar does not count as a reply, come back here to RSVP when ready.
Come when you can. Swimmers on under clothes saves a lot of time.
Grown-ups in or poolside, whichever you like.
Candles, a song, and cake for everyone.
Siblings welcome, just include them in your numbers.
Swimmers, a towel and a hat
A light spread, and cake at 4
Bring something for the table if you feel inspired. No pressure at all.
We look forward to celebrating with you
With love from Gabriel's mum and dad
